leagues.name: Ligue 1 McDonald's
notes: All 18 clubs for 2026-27 are present with a home kit; shirt sponsors are unrated.
Four clubs carried Gulf state-linked front brands in 2026-27: PSG (Qatar Airways), Lyon (Emirates), Paris FC (Bahrain Victorious), Troyes (Etihad Airways).
PSG also carries Visit Rwanda; Marseille carries Sublime Côte d'Ivoire (sleeve) and Monaco carries R.D.Congo (sleeve).
Title sponsor McDonald's is not state-linked.

claims.text: Human Rights Watch reports that in 2026 Bahraini authorities arbitrarily arrested dozens of people, that Mohammed Almosawi died in custody with signs of torture after being forcibly disappeared, and that 67 people had their citizenship stripped; imprisoned rights defenders and political leaders including Abdulhadi al-Khawaja remain arbitrarily detained.
claims.short: Arbitrary arrests, a death in custody and citizenship-stripping in 2026 (HRW).

source.name: Human Rights Watch — Bahrain country page

claims.text: Human Rights Watch said Ivorian authorities should investigate the killing of more than 50 people in the violence around the October 2020 presidential election, with a dozen opposition leaders arrested and justice for the 2010-11 crisis still incomplete.

source.name: Human Rights Watch — Côte d'Ivoire, 'Post-Election Violence, Repression'

claims.text: Human Rights Watch describes a dire situation in eastern DR Congo: over 100 armed groups active, martial law facilitating abuses by government security forces, 5.8 million internally displaced, and attacks on free expression and assembly.

source.name: Human Rights Watch — Democratic Republic of Congo country page

proposedRatings.reasoning: State-as-sponsor: the front-of-shirt brand is the Bahraini state promoting itself. Same order of severity as the UAE state brands (arbitrary mass detentions, a 2026 death in custody, citizenship-stripping), so serious rather than severe.
Côte d'Ivoire state tourism brand. Less severe record than the Gulf states (post-election violence and stalled justice), so proposed concern rather than serious. Sleeve placement.

DR Congo state brand on Monaco's sleeve. Government security forces are among the documented abusers in eastern Congo amid the M23 war, so serious. Sleeve placement; note the sponsor is the Congolese state, not Rwanda.

unsourced: Front/back/sleeve/shorts placements for most clubs were read off the 2026-27 Ligue 1 'Personnel and kits' table (Wikipedia, used as a lead only) and cross-checked against each club's official partner page; they have not all been re-verified against a season kit-launch photo.

Bing/Google side-by-side kit-launch pages for Le Havre, Toulouse, Paris FC and PSG could not be fetched (several club sites and the Qatar Airways newsroom block automated fetching); PSG back (Snipes) and sleeve (BEYOND Developments) sources are the club site rather than a dated release.
Angers' main front partner 'École Noir&Blanc' is listed by the club but its nature/owner is not confirmed.

Bahrain's current equity in Paris FC is unclear after the Nov 2024 Arnault/Agache takeover (reported shareholders Agache, Ferracci, Red Bull, BRI); the front brand 'Victorious Bahrain' is a state promotion vehicle rather than a recorded shareholding.

Qatar Airways press release (qatarairways.com, id 246428) returned 403; Qatar Sports Investments' exact ownership chain to the Qatar Investment Authority is widely reported but not verified from a filing in this pass.
